title: Version deprecation: automated notices, migration helpers, and performance profile propagation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Define and deliver an automated, low-friction deprecation workflow for older model versions that protects production customers, encourages timely migrations, and ensures performance profiles and pinning metadata remain accurate. This ticket covers: (1) notifications (console banner, emails, API headers), (2) migration helpers (client CLI script, migration playbook, compatibility matrix), (3) publishing/performance-profile propagation to replacement variants, and (4) operational metrics and rollback controls. We must support customers who have pinned model versions in the API and console, minimize surprise regressions, and coordinate engineering, SDK, and docs work.

Background: As we onboard new model variants and publish optimized performance profiles, we inevitably need to retire older checkpoints to reduce maintenance surface and ensure catalog accuracy. Current process is ad-hoc and relies on manual comms, causing confusion for teams with pinned versions. This ticket standardizes cadence and surface area for deprecation notices, automatic aliasing to replacement variants when safe, and an audit trail for admins.

Scope (out of scope for this ticket): billing changes, dedicated customer contract negotiations, on-prem upgrade automation beyond notification, changes to SLA terms.

Key constraints and risks: (a) Some customers intentionally pin to exact commit-level variants for reproducibility — we must not silently change pinned responses. (b) Performance profile differences can materially change latency/cost; migration guides must show delta. (c) Automated aliasing must be reversible and observable.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows deprecation banner for model versions scheduled for sunset with clear end-of-life date and migration link
API adds structured deprecation metadata to model list responses and optional X-Deprecation header for requests served by deprecated versions
Migration helper (CLI script) exists that analyzes a customer config, shows performance/cost deltas, and suggests replacement variant aliases
Performance profiles for replacement variants are published and linked from the deprecation notice page
Rollout plan documented with 90/60/30/14/7 day notice cadence and automated email templates
Metrics dashboard surfaces pinned usage by customer, adoption rate for migrations, and alerts when pinned-usage remains >10% after 30 days
Playbook captures rollback steps and owner escalation (SRE/PM/Account) for migration regressions
tasks: Design console banner + deprecation page UX (Design) with migration CTA
Add deprecation fields to model catalog API: deprecation_state, sunset_date, replacement_aliases (Engineering)
SDK/CLI migration helper: detect pinned usage, run sample prompts against replacement variants, compute token cost and avg latency deltas (Developer Experience)
Create performance-profile publishing flow: mark published profile as replacement-linked and surface diffs on notice page (Runtime/Model Onboarding)
Email cadence and templates: prepare 90/60/30/14/7 day templates and a final shutdown notice (Marketing/Support/Customer Success)
Instrumentation: dashboard for pinned-usage, migration attempts, and error/regression rates post-migration (Observability)
Run internal canary: apply deprecation to non-production models and try automated aliasing; log issues and iterate (SRE)
decisions: Standard deprecation period will be 90 days from first public notice, with an optional extended window for enterprise customers negotiated separately

We will NOT automatically remap pinned exact-version identifiers to new binaries without explicit customer opt-in; console and API can offer one-click upgrade that performs remapping after a preview run
Performance profiles are authoritative source of expected latency/cost and will be published alongside the deprecation notice; migration helper will use these profiles to estimate deltas
Deprecation metadata exposure will be additive only: model list includes deprecation tags and a dedicated /deprecation endpoint for machine-readable hooks
